items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 34:1
items.html: For these records are from direct light, as the ARI says here in Chapter 2, Item 10, and the last phase does not receive direct light at all, because of the screen upon her, as is known. (Chapter 2, Item 6)
